faq.q: Will my flowers look exactly like the pictures?
faq.a: We work with you to create a mood board and samples, so you know exactly what to expect. Every arrangement is made fresh the morning of your event, so it will match your vision.

faq.q: What if I don't know what I want?

blog_posts.title: Choosing wedding flowers for your season
blog_posts.excerpt: How to select the best blooms for your wedding day, whatever the time of year.
blog_posts.body:
Spring weddings bring soft pastels and delicate blossoms like peonies and tulips. These flowers are at their peak in the early months of the year, offering a fresh and romantic look.

Summer allows for bold, vibrant choices such as sunflowers, dahlias and roses. These blooms thrive in warmer weather and can add a striking pop of colour to your arrangements.

Autumn and winter weddings benefit from deeper tones and textured flowers like anemones, ranunculus and berries. These create a rich, seasonal feel that complements cooler weather.

blog_posts.title: How to keep your flowers fresh all day
blog_posts.excerpt: Simple steps to ensure your wedding flowers stay vibrant from ceremony to reception.
blog_posts.body:
Start with fresh flowers. We arrange everything the morning of your event to ensure maximum freshness. Ask us about our delivery and setup service to keep blooms looking their best.

Keep arrangements out of direct sunlight and away from heat sources. This helps prevent wilting and keeps colours vibrant for longer.

A light mist of water can help revive flowers during the day. Ask your venue if they can assist with this, or we can provide guidance on the best way to care for your specific arrangements.
